paragraphs: COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Commercial Lease Agreement is made on January 15, 2026 between Harbor Properties LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (Landlord), and Maple Street Bakery Inc., a California corporation (Tenant).
1. Premises
Landlord leases to Tenant the ground-floor retail unit at 12 Harbor Way, Oakland, California, comprising approximately 2,400 rentable square feet.
2. Term
The term of this Lease is five (5) years, beginning on March 1, 2026 (the Commencement Date) and ending on February 28, 2031, unless terminated earlier under this Lease.
3. Rent
Tenant shall pay monthly Base Rent of $4,500 in advance on the first day of each month.
Base Rent increases by three percent (3%) on each anniversary of the Commencement Date.
A late charge of five percent (5%) of the overdue amount applies to any payment received more than five (5) days after its due date.
4. Security Deposit

Tenant shall deposit $9,000 with Landlord as security for its obligations. Landlord shall return the deposit within thirty (30) days after the Lease ends, less any amounts applied to unpaid rent or damage beyond normal wear and tear.
5. Early Termination

Tenant may terminate this Lease early, effective at the end of the thirty-sixth (36th) month of the Term, by giving Landlord at least six (6) months' prior written notice and paying an early termination fee equal to three (3) months' Base Rent.
6. Use
Tenant shall use the Premises only as a retail bakery and cafe, and for no other purpose without Landlord's prior written consent.
7. Maintenance and Repairs
Landlord shall maintain the roof, foundation and structural walls. Tenant shall keep the interior of the Premises, including plumbing fixtures and kitchen equipment, in good repair.
8. Assignment and Subletting
Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet any part of the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which Landlord shall not unreasonably withhold.
9. Insurance
Tenant shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence, naming Landlord as an additional insured.
10. Indemnification

Tenant shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Landlord and its members, managers, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all claims, demands, losses, liabilities, damages, judgments, penalties, costs and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising out of or relating to Tenant's use or occupancy of the Premises, any act or omission of Tenant or its employees, contractors or invitees, or any breach by Tenant of this Lease, except to the extent caused by Landlord's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
11. Default
If Tenant fails to pay rent within ten (10) days after written notice that it is overdue, Landlord may terminate this Lease and recover possession of the Premises.
12. Governing Law
This Lease is governed by the laws of the State of California.
13. Notices
All notices under this Lease must be in writing and delivered by hand, by courier or by certified mail to the addresses of the parties stated above.
